boundaries: Asserted parameters (parallel fraction, availability, rate) are inputs, never measured claims about any real system.
Distinguish speedup from efficiency, sustained from peak rate, and decimal from binary data units; state the convention and never silently mix them.
Exclude queueing theory needing distributions, cache replacement policies, power/thermal models and any vendor or system recommendation.
No benchmark claims, capacity plans or performance predictions for specific hardware.
Availability products require explicitly asserted independence, matching the probability lane's rule.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: Dimensionless ratios, counts, durations and data amounts; meanings (speedup, parallel_fraction, data_size, transfer_rate, availability and similar) are new and require extension. All seed forms are scalar + - * / ** and fit the engine once meanings exist. Data-size units (bytes/records) need explicit unit decisions at integration time.
mission: Curate atomic, reusable deterministic computing-system arithmetic: speedup laws, storage/transfer accounting and availability composition, each with explicit workload and system assumptions. Continue through successive review batches during the sustained session; no benchmark chain or system evaluation is required. This is formal definition work, not performance prediction.
priorities: Amdahl's law speedup from parallel fraction and component speedup
Data transfer time from data size and sustained transfer rate
Storage capacity accounting from record count and record size, with unit conventions explicit
Series availability as a product of component availabilities under stated independence
special_checks: Check Amdahl boundary limits (parallel fraction 0 and 1, unbounded component speedup) as references
Guard availability inputs to [0,1]; reject missing-independence applications explicitly
Data-unit conversions go through explicit constants metadata with a stated decimal/binary convention
Transfer-rate records must state sustained vs peak and exclude protocol overhead unless sourced
starter_sources: No source URLs were preverified for this assignment. Find Hennessy and Patterson (Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach) for Amdahl's law, vendor-neutral capacity/availability definitions, or original sources such as Amdahl's 1967 AFIPS paper via a library. Record exact edition, section or DOI; discovery snippets alone do not prove the equation.
title: Computer science: speedup, capacity and availability arithmetic
